slides.headline: Bambu’s H3C packs nine tools
slides.summary: Bambu Lab teased the H3C, a tool changer with a drop-down rack for nine tools. It launches Nov 3.
slides.take: Multicolor with way less purge waste? We’re watching the price.

slides.headline: OrcaSlicer 2.5 alpha is huge
slides.summary: 950+ pull requests add plugins, color mixing and a parametric CAD tab.
slides.take: We slice everything in Orca. Waiting for stable before customer jobs.

slides.headline: Meshy goes from chat to slicer
slides.summary: A new Hermes Agent plugin generates a model, checks it, repairs it and exports a 3MF.
slides.take: We already do this with hi3D + Claude. Built-in print prep is the win.
